Appointment Scheduler

Search saved patients first, select the patient, then set the follow-up date and time.

12-hour time (AM / PM)

ഇവിടെ കൊടുക്കുന്ന fee വാങ്ങിക്കഴിഞ്ഞതായി കണക്കാക്കി Collection Report-ൽ ചേർക്കും.

Follow-ups added from Billing appear here with “Time not set”; use Set time to choose the appointment time. Cloud sync requires Owner/Admin login. Appointments are also included in Download Backup. Keep the app open to see upcoming/overdue reminders; a standalone HTML file cannot reliably send reminders while closed.

Staff Attendance

Punch In / Punch Out buttons record the official server time. Punch In is allowed at any time. Late arrivals receive a warning; three consecutive late attendance days trigger a half-day leave review notice.

Log in with your individual staff account to record attendance.

Today's Status

No attendance recorded yet.

Punch In is allowed at any time. More than 10 minutes after your scheduled shift start is marked late. Three consecutive late attendance days trigger a half-day leave review notice. Punch Out records the server time.

Attendance Records (Owner/Admin)

Staff Accounts

Create a cloud username and password for each staff member. Accounts are shared securely between devices. Work hours and monthly salary are saved in the shared database for attendance and later salary calculations.

Registered Staff

Backup & Restore

Backup medicines, bills, consultation histories, appointments and clinic settings to a file. Keep the file outside this browser/device.

Owner/Admin clinical, prescription, billing, medicine, scheduler and report data sync to Cloud after secure login. Other devices refresh Cloud changes automatically about every 15 seconds. To bring unsynced data from an older file/device, first download its Full Backup, then use “Merge Old Device Backup into Cloud” here; matching IDs keep the current Cloud version and backup-only records are added. Staff access is role-limited; collection reports remain Owner/Admin only. Download Full Backup regularly as an additional safety copy.
